tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The paper. In dark it is the same #1C1C1C the ink is in light, so the two themes are one pair reversed rather than two palettes.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: The ink. #1C1C1C, not #0A0A0A: nothing in this product is darker than that, in either theme. 17.0:1 light, 16.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surface: offer cards, order cards, the cash summary. Identical to background in light, one step lighter in dark, so a card only reads as separate in light because of border.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card. Same ink as foreground; kept separate so a themed card can diverge.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: select menus, the notification list, any dropdown.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one committing action of a screen, and the wordmark. There is no third colour: the logo is black type on white paper and works reversed, so an accent hue would be a thing the mark does not have.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary. 17.2:1 light, 14.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Filled but not committing: the secondary button, a filled chip.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet ground: a book cover placeholder, a disabled row, a skeleton.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: seller name, condition, timestamps, hints. 4.7:1 on background and card in light. Falls to 4.3:1 on muted in light, under the 4.5 floor - do not set it on a muted ground at body size; use foreground there.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and current state: nav tab in use, row under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Only for loss that cannot be undone: cancel an order, pull a book after ready, an overdue statement, a wrong handover code. Never for a warning. 4.8:1 light, 6.8:1 dark as text.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: card edges, dividers, the top bar rule. Decorative, so the 1.3:1 it carries is correct - a border that separates two controls needs 3:1 and takes input instead.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: The border of a text field, textarea or select - not its fill.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring. 2.6:1 on background in light, under the 3:1 floor for a meaningful mark; shadcn ships it this way and we keep it exact. Shelfcall renders the ring at 3px with a 1px offset so the thickness carries what the value does not.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Offers sent, on the seller's weekly counters.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Offers that sold.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Offers released when the reader bought elsewhere.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Commission base, month over month.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series. Unused in Shelfcall today.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The operator page's rail. Not used in the three phone apps, which navigate from a top bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text in the operator rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Current item in the operator rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hover in the operator rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Rail edge.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus in the operator rail.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: The ground a label sits on. A label has no border; it has a ground. Derived from foreground so it follows whichever theme is on. Stated as a literal here because the token format cannot hold color-mix(); bundle.css derives the same value from foreground so it follows the theme.

tokens.name: tint-strong
tokens.usage: The same ground, one step up: a selected chip, a count, a running countdown. Still no border, so it can never be mistaken for a button. Stated as a literal here because the token format cannot hold color-mix(); bundle.css derives the same value from foreground so it follows the theme.

tokens.name: tint-bad
tokens.usage: A label whose subject was lost: a lapsed window, an overdue statement. The tinted form of destructive, never the filled one. Stated as a literal here because the token format cannot hold color-mix(); bundle.css derives the same value from foreground so it follows the theme.

styles.name: text-3xl
styles.usage: Reserved. Nothing in the phone apps is set this large — a screen title is text-2xl, dropping to text-xl on a phone.

styles.name: text-2xl
styles.usage: Screen title above phone width. One per screen: Deliveries, Orders, Which book?

styles.name: text-xl
styles.usage: Screen title on a phone. A title names what you are doing; it should not outweigh the fields under it.

styles.name: text-lg
styles.usage: Book title on a card. The one place a title outranks its metadata.

styles.name: text-base
styles.usage: Body copy and the bookseller's note. Keep near 65 characters.
styles.sample: A mad-scientist novel that is funny rather than grim.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: The app's working size: buttons, inputs, list rows, most labels.

styles.name: text-sm-medium
styles.usage: Button labels and any label that names a control.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Metadata in muted-foreground: seller, branch, condition, time. Never for anything a decision rests on.

styles.name: text-xs-medium
styles.usage: Badge text and the eyebrow over a block.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: The four-digit handover code, and nothing else at this size.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Order numbers and reference strings, wherever they sit in running text.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale, which is what shadcn's components are built on. Shelfcall adds nothing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a badge and its dot; the tightest gap that still reads.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between sibling buttons in a row; inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked cards in a list; label to field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, list row padding, and the page's side gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page side gutter above phone width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between one section of a screen and the next.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a section heading that follows other content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height. A control shorter than this is a bug on a phone.

radius.note: shadcn derives four values from one --radius (0.625rem = 10px): sm = radius - 4, md = radius - 2, lg = radius, xl = radius + 4. Resolved here because a token value cannot hold calc().

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base. Change this one number and the other four move with it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, the smallest controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, alerts, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and anything full-bleed with rounded top corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only genuinely circular things: the avatar button, the unread count, the toast.
